news.title: Raghav Juyal Shares Heartfelt Note for Nani Following The Paradise
news.summary: Actor Raghav Juyal expressed deep appreciation for Nani, calling him a safe space and an invaluable guide after starring alongside him in The Paradise. He credited the lead actor for spending hours discussing cinema and life to help him maintain clarity during his career. The gritty action drama, directed by Srikanth Odela, also features Mohan Babu and Kayadu Lohar in significant roles.

news.title: KT Rama Rao Plan to Catch Nani's The Paradise in Theaters
news.summary: BRS Working President KT Rama Rao announced via social media that he will visit a cinema hall to watch Nani's latest release, The Paradise. KTR praised both the lead actor and director Srikanth Odela, noting that his theater visit comes after a long hiatus. The film's narrative includes a political character named MLA Shankaranna, drawing attention due to its fictionalized inspirations from regional incidents.

news.title: Chiranjeevi Keeps Silent on Vishwambhara Amid New Project Buzz
news.summary: Megastar Chiranjeevi's ongoing silence regarding his socio-fantasy venture Vishwambhara has sparked speculation among fans. While the actor has actively shared updates and promotional details for his upcoming film Kaaka directed by Bobby, he has avoided public discussions about the Mallidi Vasishta project. Observers note that the silence follows initial criticism of the teaser's visual effects, leaving supporters waiting for clarity.

news.title: Vicky Kaushal Reveals Retro Look in Sanjay Leela Bhansali's Multilingual Project
news.summary: The makers of Sanjay Leela Bhansali's upcoming directorial Love And War have released the first-look poster featuring Vicky Kaushal. Sporting an intense expression while lighting a cigar, the actor joins a lead cast that includes Ranbir Kapoor and Alia Bhatt. The multilingual cinematic venture is slated for a theatrical release on January 21, 2027.

news.title: Hombale Films Takes Charge of South Theatrical Release for Hanuman Ansh
news.summary: The successful low-budget feature Hanuman Ansh has found a new distribution home after earlier Telugu release arrangements were canceled. Prominent Kannada banner Hombale Films has secured the entire South theatrical rights for the film. They plan to bring the movie to audiences in Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, and Malayalam soon.

news.title: Young Tiger NTR to Grace Pre-Release Event of Don't Trouble The Trouble
news.summary: Fahadh Faasil stars in the upcoming movie Don't Trouble The Trouble, directed by Shashank Yeleti and slated for an October 2, 2026 release. With promotional material receiving a positive response, the makers are hosting a pre-release event. Actor NTR is set to attend the gathering as the chief guest.

news.title: Chiranjeevi's Playful Quip About Trolling Sparks Laughter at Sigma Event
news.summary: Megastar Chiranjeevi amused attendees at the Sigma pre-release event in Hyderabad with lighthearted banter targeting online trolls. While speaking with actress Faria Abdullah, he jokingly questioned if she missed dancing with him in Vishwambhara due to attempts to block others' growth. His humorous reaction quickly gained traction online.

news.title: Chiranjeevi Confirms Sankranti Arrival for Kaaka
news.summary: Megastar Chiranjeevi has provided fresh production updates regarding his upcoming film Kaaka, directed by Bobby, confirming a Sankranti 2027 release. The project has completed its entire first half and about 30 percent of the second half, with music director Thaman already handling dubbing and score duties. However, the actor remained silent on the release timeline of his other venture, Vishwambhara.

news.title: Vicky Kaushal Reveals Rugged Look for Sanjay Leela Bhansali's Period Drama
news.summary: Vicky Kaushal has shared his intense first-look poster for Sanjay Leela Bhansali's multi-starrer period film Love & War. Sporting facial wounds and a vintage aesthetic, the actor stars alongside Ranbir Kapoor and Alia Bhatt in the 1960s-set wartime drama. The worldwide release is slated for January 21, 2027, across multiple languages.

news.title: Nani's The Paradise Crosses Century Milestone Rapidly
news.summary: Actor Nani's period action drama The Paradise has stormed the box office, racing past the 100 crore gross mark globally within just two days. Directed by Srikanth Odela, the Sudhakar Cherukuri production is posting stellar numbers across Telugu states, overseas territories, and the Hindi market. Strong advance bookings suggest the film will sustain its massive momentum through the opening weekend.

news.title: Megastar Praises Rapid Progress of Bobby Directorial
news.summary: During a promotional appearance for Sundeep Kishan's Sigma, Megastar Chiranjeevi highlighted the swift production pace of his upcoming venture Kaaka. Directed by Bobby Kolli, the action drama features a completed first half and ongoing background work by composer Thaman. The star reaffirmed that the large-scale project stays on track for a theatrical outing during Sankranti 2027.

news.title: Taapsee Pannu Recalls Being Dropped From a Film Due to Lead Actor's Wife
news.summary: Actress Taapsee Pannu recently shared a bizarre industry experience where she was replaced in a movie after her dates were already confirmed. She was informed that the lead actor's wife did not like her, making it one of the strangest reasons she ever lost a project. Taapsee noted how such sudden removals disrupt an actor's planning and cause them to miss out on other major opportunities.

news.title: High Stakes Ahead for Mythri Film Distributors in Nizam and Beyond
news.summary: Mythri Film Distributors faces a crucial upcoming month as they heavily invest in multiple big-budget releases across regions. Despite facing negative talk on recent ventures like The Paradise, they are pushing forward to secure their foothold against competitors. With several high-profile titles lined up over the next few weeks, successful box office runs will be vital to safeguard their financial balance sheet.

news.title: The Paradise Day 2 Box Office: Strong Nizam Hold Cushions Drops in AP and Overseas
news.summary: Natural Star Nani's starrer The Paradise grossed approximately Rs. 19 crores on its second day at the box office. While overseas territories and Andhra Pradesh experienced heavy drops following negative talk, Telangana delivered a superb performance led by Nizam. The film aims to pick up momentum over the weekend to recover lost ground in other regions.

news.title: Venkatesh and Trivikram's Aadarsha Kutumbam Shifts Release Date and Drops Song Update
news.summary: The family entertainer Aadarsha Kutumbam, starring Venkatesh and directed by Trivikram, has postponed its theatrical arrival from October 2 to October 9. Along with the schedule change, the makers announced that a special track featuring Srinidhi Shetty, Nivetha Pethuraj, Dimple Hayathi, and Venkatesh will be released tomorrow. Bankrolled by China Babu, the movie also features Nara Rohith, Rao Ramesh, and Satya in key roles.

news.title: Nani Confronts Criticism as The Paradise Holds Strong After Record Opening
news.summary: Despite facing mixed reviews and online trolling following its release, Nani's starrer The Paradise managed a massive opening day collection exceeding ₹75 crore. The core team, including the lead actor and director Srikanth Odela, is actively engaging with the media to address the feedback. Solid occupancy in key centers is helping the movie maintain steady momentum heading into the crucial weekend.

news.title: Actress Preity Mukhundhan Bags the Lead Role Opposite Dhanush in D56
news.summary: Rising actress Preity Mukhundhan has secured a major career milestone by signing on as the female lead in Dhanush's upcoming film, tentatively titled D56. Directed by Tamizharasan Pachamuthu, the project officially commenced production with a traditional pooja ceremony near Madurai. The film also features prominent actors SJ Suryah and Vadivelu in key roles.

news.title: Overseas Box Office Sees Sharp Decline for Nani's The Paradise on Day Two
news.summary: After registering a phenomenal international opening of $2.3 million on its first day, Nani's latest theatrical venture experienced a steep drop in overseas markets. Collecting only $250K on its second day, the film's two-day international total stands at $2.55 million. The abrupt slowdown highlights the immediate impact of mixed word-of-mouth on offshore ticket sales.

news.title: Nani's The Paradise Exhibits Tremendous Staying Power in Nizam
news.summary: Natural Star Nani's action-thriller The Paradise has set a new benchmark for medium-scale ventures in Telangana by pulling in a massive opening share. Despite facing mostly negative feedback from critics, the Srikanth Odela directorial maintained an extraordinary pace on its second day. Consequently, the film's two-day distributor share has comfortably crossed the Rs. 18 crores mark.

news.title: Chiranjeevi Shocks Netizens with a Witty Self-Deprecating Jab
news.summary: Megastar Chiranjeevi surprised attendees and internet users alike by openly cracking a joke about online trolls at a recent promotional event. Addressing co-star Faria Abdullah playfully on stage, he referenced the malicious internet memes targeting him. This clever reaction proved that the veteran actor closely tracks social media chatter and handles negativity with characteristic humor.

news.title: Chiranjeevi Compares Sundeep Kishan's Drive to His Own Early Days
news.summary: Iconic actor Chiranjeevi graced the pre-release gathering for Sundeep Kishan's upcoming heist action comedy, Sigma, as the chief guest. During the event, Chiranjeevi lauded the lead actor for consistently selecting novel scripts, noting that this hunger for distinct identities mirrored his own early career. The movie, directed by Jason Sanjay and backed by Lyca Productions, is slated to arrive in theaters on October 2.

news.title: The Paradise Defies Negative Feedback With Strong Day Two Numbers
news.summary: Despite weathering critical disapproval that typically causes box-office collapses, Nani's latest outing successfully sustained its momentum. Trade figures indicate that the movie hauled a worldwide gross of over Rs. 20 crores on its second day alone. Industry analysts point out that while stronger word-of-mouth could have pushed the film into record-shattering territory, Nani's strong personal brand has helped secure a stable run.

news.title: Vijay Deverakonda Steps Into Battle in Fresh Poster for Ranabaali
news.summary: The creators of the upcoming pan-India historical drama Ranabaali have revealed a brand-new poster highlighting Vijay Deverakonda in a fierce warrior avatar. Directed by Rahul Sankrityan and co-starring Rashmika Mandanna, the 19th-century epic is slated for a worldwide theatrical release on October 16, 2026. Mythri Movie Makers is producing the venture, which draws inspiration from real historical events during British rule.

news.title: Jr NTR to Grace Pre-Release Event of Don’t Trouble The Trouble
news.summary: The upcoming Telugu movie Don’t Trouble The Trouble, featuring Fahadh Faasil in his debut Telugu lead role, is gearing up for its theatrical arrival. Presented by SS Rajamouli, the project is looking to boost its pre-release buzz with an upcoming promotional event featuring Jr NTR as the chief guest. The makers hope that this high-profile appearance will help amplify audience interest across the region.
